`total()` now multiplies each item's price by its quantity. The unit tests in `test/cart.test.js` pass (3/3).

The fix is in `src/cart.js`. I replaced the loop with `items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.qty, 0)`.

One side effect: an empty cart now returns `0`. The old code returned `NaN` for an empty array, because `sum` started as `undefined`. A quick check confirmed `total([{price:2,qty:3},{price:3,qty:2}])` returns `12` and `total([])` returns `0`.

The existing tests only cover quantity 1, so they don't exercise the bug I fixed. I didn't add a test for it, since you asked me to run the existing ones. Say if you want a quantity > 1 case added to `test/cart.test.js`.
